# Error #51: BeneficiaryNotEnrolled

<!-- Generated by tooling/generate-error-catalog.mjs. Do not edit manually. -->

## Summary
- **Numeric Code**: `#51`
- **Variant Name**: `BeneficiaryNotEnrolled`
- **Status**: Active (Enforced)
- **Client Toast Level**: `ERROR`
- **Retryable**: `Yes`

---

## Trigger Conditions
The contract rejects the call when any of these registry conditions holds:
- `Branch::BeneficiaryNotEnrolled` — the beneficiary has not enrolled an ed25519 consent key.

---

## Minimal Reproduction

No dedicated test names this condition; the registry matrix builds it directly below. `rejected!` records the fired branch and asserts its mapped code.

```rust
// BeneficiaryNotEnrolled — excerpt from error_surface_test.rs
let f = Fixture::setup_quiet();
let sponsor = Address::generate(&f.env);
register_sponsor(&f, &sponsor, 10_000, 10_000);
let id = f.create_stream(DEPOSIT, DAY, 10 * DAY, false);
f.advance_time(2 * DAY); // accrue so the amount checks pass
                         // Deliberately skip `enroll_beneficiary`.
Some(rejected!(sponsored_claim(&f, &sponsor, id, 1, 1, {
    f.env.ledger().timestamp() + DAY
})))
```

Run the matrix proof:

```bash
cargo test -p streampay-contract --locked error_surface_matrix_proves_every_branch_is_reachable
```

---

## User Remediation Guidance
> **Plain-Language Remediation**:  
> Enroll the beneficiary's ed25519 consent key with `enroll_beneficiary` before the relay; `sponsored_withdraw` verifies the signed claim against that enrolled key.
>
> **Reference**: [`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md#13-gas-sponsorship-relayed-claims-without-a-mempool-relayer`](../../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md#13-gas-sponsorship-relayed-claims-without-a-mempool-relayer)
